main_text.p: fumus, Ioan.10.verf.30. Sed tamen impudenter ab iftis & pluribus quidem eorum fynodis vox ὁμοούσιον & ὁμοιούσιον damnata eft, vti Philippenfi, Antiochena, Seleuciana, Nicea, quę à Nicæ vrbe Thraciæ dicta eft, & à Valente & Vrfatio im-puriffimis canibus & Epifcopis fub Conftan-tio congregata. Ariminenfis quidem fynodus vocem ὁμοούσιον omnino & de induftria & caute, ne quid turbarum contra Conftantij edictum moueret, prætermisit, Homoufianos tamen damnauit. Sic igitur vox hæc exagitata eft, adeo quidè vt in Chriftum, & in Filium ὁμοούσιον Patri credere propofitum fit à Græcis hominibus quibufdam Latinis Epifcopis linguæ Græcæ ignaris, velut quædam duo fibi plane contraria & repugnantia, Ruffin. lib.1.cap.23. Sed tamen quia Nicenæ fynodi plurimum, & iure quidem, semper valuit autoritas, Acatius hic, à quo Aca-tiani (alius enim eft Acatius Eutychianus, qui & ipse quoque damnatus eft, & de quo cano, Acatius.1.& 2.24.quæst.ii[?] fit mentio) falsò qui-dem conciliandarum Ecclesiarum prætextu vo-luit in Seleuciana synodo quæ sub Constantio Imperatore conuenit, pro ὁμοούσιον Chriftu, fub-stitui, dicíque ὁμοιούσιον. Nam eum ἑτερούσιον ap-pellare durius videbatur, quàm vt recipi ab or-thodoxis & Niccnam fidem fequentibus pos-set, præterquàm quòd etiam Constantij edicto ad placandas, vt ille voluit, tantas episcoporum rixas, stricte vetitum erat, ne Chriftus vel ἑτεροούσιος vel ὁμοιούσιος diceretur. Ergo tolerabilis vi-debatur Acatij sententia, sed cum sub eo fuco & melle venenum maximum lateret, obstiterũt patres,

page.notes: Long s was read as s throughout. The Greek words are copied with their accents as far as the scan shows them; the accents on ὁμοούσιον and the ἑτερούσιον forms are slightly blurred. "2.24.quæst.ii[?]" is hard to read at the line break. "Nicæ" is uncertain: the scan may read "Nicea" or "Nicē". The mark at the lower left of the page is not clearly a signature, so it is left out. Hyphens at line ends are printed hyphens and were kept.
